query:
SELECT actor_id,
                  payload::text                              AS "body!",
                  payload -> 'old' ->> 'password_fingerprint' AS old_fingerprint,
                  payload -> 'new' ->> 'password_fingerprint' AS new_fingerprint
             FROM audit.log
            WHERE table_name = 'core.users' AND row_id = $1 AND action = 'UPDATE'
            ORDER BY id
